quests.name: Short on Yew Logs
quests.summary: The banker of Seluford has run out of yew logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 22 yew logs and nobody in Seluford has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Archery Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Seluford to the archery shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the archery shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the general store keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Banker
quests.summary: Call on the banker of Seluford and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the banker and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The barber sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Seluford Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Seluford Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Seluford Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Spiders
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper wants the spider near Seluford thinned out.
intro: The spider beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 14 of them close to Seluford and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Bones
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper of Seluford has run out of bones.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 17 bones and nobody in Seluford has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Barber
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Seluford to the barber.
intro: This should have gone to the barber days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the clothes shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Barber
quests.summary: Call on the barber of Seluford and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the barber and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The food shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Supply Run to Varenhollow
quests.summary: Gather raw swordfish for the banker, then carry a shipment to Varenhollow.
intro: I have an order from Varenhollow and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 17 raw swordfish, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the banker in Seluford.
From Seluford? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Seluford and bring back mithril ore.
intro: The wilds around Seluford need a firm hand. Start with 14 giant rat outside the walls, then 22 giant spider down in Seluford Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 22 mithril ore to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Seluford for the barber.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the clothes shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The barber asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the magic shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the clothes shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Seluford Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant rat out of Seluford Sewers and tell the archery shop keeper.
intro: Seluford Sewers is crawling with giant rat, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 22 of them, then let the archery shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Seluford owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Seluford Sewers is clearer than it was. 22 giant rat fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Varenhollow (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Gather willow logs for the archery shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Varenhollow.
intro: I have an order from Varenhollow and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 28 willow logs, then take the packed shipment to the archery shop keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the archery shop keeper in Seluford.
From Seluford? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt (Magic Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Seluford and bring back big bones.
intro: The wilds around Seluford need a firm hand. Start with 14 giant spider outside the walls, then 22 king scorpion down in Seluford Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 17 big bones to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council (Clothes Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Gather support around Seluford for the clothes shop keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the food shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The clothes shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the realtor does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the food shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Seluford Sewers (Food Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Clear king scorpion out of Seluford Sewers and tell the sword shop keeper.
intro: Seluford Sewers is crawling with king scorpion, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 22 of them, then let the sword shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Seluford owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Seluford Sewers is clearer than it was. 22 king scorpion fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: The Seluford Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Seluford and Varenhollow.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Varenhollow. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 34 spider near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the general store keeper in Seluford.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Varenhollow is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Seluford has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Seluford
quests.summary: Find what rules Seluford Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Plague Warden.
intro: Something rules Seluford Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the sword shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Seluford is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Plague Warden.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Plague Warden is dead. Seluford Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Rootbound Hollow, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Rootbound Hollow has stood against Seluford for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the clothes shop keeper, fight your way through 34 earth warrior and end The Broodmother.
Bring 22 raw tuna back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Rootbound Hollow?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Seluford: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.
